name: Codeine-N-oxide
summary: Codeine-N-oxide (genocodeine) is an active metabolite of codeine. It is an opiate listed as a Schedule I controlled substance. It has a DEA ACSCN of 9053 and its annual manufacturing quota for 2013 was 602 grams.

pharmacology.text: Codeine-N-oxide (genocodeine) is an active metabolite of codeine.

uses.text: Like morphine-N-oxide, it was studied as a potential pharmaceutical drug and is considerably weaker than codeine.

summaryZh: 可待因-N-氧化物是可待因的活性代謝產物。它是一種阿片類藥物，被美國列為一級管制物質。其美國緝毒局行政管制物質代碼為9053，2013年的年度生產配額為602克。在中國大陸，該物質被列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。在台灣，該物質被列入第二級毒品。
